definitions.explanation: The grain-bearing tip of a rice plant, often seen bending as the rice ripens.

examples.japanese: {稲穂|いなほ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{黄金色|こがねいろ}→黄金色：19037_koganeiro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{輝|かがや}いている→輝く：02032_kagayaku⟧。
examples.english: The ears of rice are shining golden.
In autumn, the ears of rice droop.

examples.japanese: ⟦{実|みの}る→実る：00282_minoru⟧ほど{頭|こうべ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{垂|た}れる→垂れる：10075_tareru⟧{稲穂|いなほ}⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧な。
examples.english: The more the rice ripens, the more it bends its head.
examples.notes: A famous proverb meaning that the wiser a person becomes, the more humble they are.

notes:
{稲穂|いなほ} refers to the ear or head of a rice plant — the grain-bearing part that droops when ripe.

FORMS:
⟦{稲|いね}→稲：01820_ine⟧ (rice plant) + {穂|ほ} (ear, head of grain).

CULTURAL NOTE:
Appears in the famous proverb: ⟦{実|みの}る→実る：00282_minoru⟧ほど{頭|こうべ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{垂|た}れる→垂れる：10075_tareru⟧{稲穂|いなほ}⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧な — "The more the rice ripens, the more the head bows." This teaches that truly accomplished people remain humble.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {稲穂|いなほ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{実|みの}る→実る：00282_minoru⟧: the rice ears ripen
- {稲穂|いなほ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{揺|ゆ}れる→揺れる：01161_yureru⟧: the rice ears sway (in the wind)
- ⟦{黄金色|こがねいろ}→黄金色：19037_koganeiro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{稲穂|いなほ}: golden rice ears

USAGE:
A seasonal word (⟦{季語|きご}→季語：09561_kigo⟧) for autumn in haiku, evoking harvest time and the Japanese countryside.
